actions.action: Push a finger an inch into the soil to check moisture
Water thoroughly until it drains and empty the saucer after 10-15 minutes
If soil has pulled away, soak the pot in a tub of water for 20-30 minutes
Going forward, water when the top inch of soil is dry
Remove or fill the watering globe
Move plant to bright indirect light
Remove dead, crispy leaves at the base
If soil stays wet or stems go mushy, check the roots for overwatering

reason: The answer leads with underwatering, the opposite of the confirmed overwatering, and treats low light only as a secondary issue. It misses the vine-layering fix. Its watering advice is gated by a soil-moisture check, so it is not harmful.
